criteria.requirement: Reproducible unit, widget, golden and acceptance commands are documented with pinned toolchain prerequisites
criteria.reason: Documentation command review is required; CI docs job and repository-wide acceptance tests provide supporting evidence, not an automatic proof of handbook accuracy

criteria.requirement: Native build prerequisites and unsupported host capabilities are explicit
criteria.reason: Platform-specific prerequisites and unsupported Windows host control require maintainer review

criteria.requirement: No secret-containing artifacts, unapproved egress or unsafe permission claims are introduced
criteria.reason: Documentation-only change; reviewer must verify privacy and security claims

criteria.requirement: CI and relevant acceptance tests green with reproduction commands
criteria.reason: Review exact-head required CI checks and sanitized acceptance-evidence artifact before merging
